$comment: Where StoryRail finds the backlog and the applications. Applications are not listed here: each story names them in its "## Applications" section, and StoryRail finds them as repos in github.org. See docs/storyrail/SETUP.md.

apps.$comment: Only what can't be found from the repo itself. map: a story name that isn't the repo name ("name": "owner/repo"), the type when a repo has both package.json and pom.xml, apiTests = a backend whose API tests live in a repo of their own, qaUrl = where its QA deploy is served (default: the repo's homepage).

appTypes.$comment: How each kind of application is built and tested. The same for every app of that kind; an app's own README or package.json scripts win when they say otherwise.

frontend.verify: npm ci && npm run lint && npm run typecheck && npm run test:coverage && npm run build && npm audit --audit-level=high

backend.stub: WireMock (or what the app's tests already use), fed from the provider's contract

squad.$comment: The squad as shown on the dashboard. Rename people freely; stations are the status ids each member reports on; brief = the agent's file name (sr-*) or 'orchestrator'. A station like dev@frontend stands for the build of every frontend application of the run (dev@library-frontend, …).
